title: Porous polysiloxane MWCNT nanocomposites for high-performance and scalable triboelectric nanogenerators
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,31917-31930
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05894E, Paper

Orkhan Gulahmadov, Lala Gahramanli, Mustafa Muradov, Nahida Musayeva, Stefano Bellucci, Nadia Todorova, Christos Trapalis
Porous polysiloxane/MWCNT nanocomposites were fabricated as triboelectric films for TENGs. Optimized porosity improved surface morphology, charge storage, and interfacial contact, enhancing device output.
